preregistration.primary_comparison: K1 against K, paired on identical seeds: calm-only configuration diversity and speech-like share, plus every other configuration (expected identical).
preregistration.prior_gates: The Phase 2J.1 gates are reported unchanged for K1 against B, the frame used for the Phase 2K check. No gate is added, removed or changed.
preregistration.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: Calm diversity of the unguarded routes (B ~4.06, K ~4.71) is inflated by speech-like tracks (Phase 2H.8.1, 2K). A lower guarded calm diversity is therefore reported as the removal of that inflation, not as a regression in variety, and guarded calm diversity is not claimed as a gain over B.
preregistration.scope_of_claims: K1 matches the Phase 2J.1 guarded selection on the calm-only route only; the three uplift mixes containing calm stay on the unguarded previous ranking, so K1 does not reproduce the Phase 2J.1 guarded-baseline experiment as a whole.
preregistration.seeds: 42000-42049 decide the reported gate statuses; 45000-45049 replicate. Both disjoint from every earlier seed set.

prior_gates.integrity: 100% target consistency, exact shares in every list, same-seed determinism on all 12 requests

notes: Diversity is feature-space diversity, not listener-perceived variety; on calm it is inflated by speech-like tracks, so the guarded calm figure is not comparable as a gain or loss of variety.
Bootstrap intervals describe sampling variability over 50 seeded runs on one catalog only.
Cold start covers a calm-only request in a fresh process, including the one-time cell build.
